priorExposureExclusions.treatment: any repository, benchmark lineage, or domain family previously previewed, structurally inspected, parsed, executed, partitioned, or scored by this project is development-exposed and cannot contribute discovery-clean evidence

deterministicRolePartition.ordering: ascending SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of UTF-8 candidateIdentity
deterministicRolePartition.developmentRole: first eligible candidate in deterministic order
deterministicRolePartition.protectedConfirmationRole: second and later eligible candidates in deterministic order
deterministicRolePartition.ifFewerThanTwoEligibleFamilies: freeze source-feasibility deferral without relaxing gates, reusing exposed sources, or inspecting implementations

postPartitionStructuralGates.stageBoundary: these gates are preregistered now but may be evaluated only after the metadata inventory and roles are durably locked
postPartitionStructuralGates.onlyPermittedProjectLayer: a persistent uniform-prior permutation over source-native observation labels; label renaming and belief augmentation only
postPartitionStructuralGates.horizonRule: shortest source-valid action sequence containing reference sensing, target sensing, and a delayed state-dependent control, capped at six actions

prospectiveEconomicGate.stageBoundary: evaluate after structural parity and resource locks but before any optimal contingent planner, MAP, posterior-sampling, myopic, EIG, development, or confirmation outcome
prospectiveEconomicGate.fixedPolicy: source-native reference sense, then target sense, then the source-native state-contingent control implied by their joint labels, with any source-required movement or delay inserted deterministically
prospectiveEconomicGate.comparator: exhaustive best open-loop sequence at the same horizon under the joint prior
prospectiveEconomicGate.ifAnyGateFails: freeze the candidate as a negative feasibility result; do not tune, replace it after structural inspection, or open its protected counterpart
